title: Not truly reversible
text: Not truly reversible. It’s not reversible unless you don’t care that it’s “inside out”.  It fits the way the couch is configured in the ad picture.  Also, the part that overlaps the back of the chaise portion is significantly shorter than over the couch back.  This wouldn’t be an issue if you had it placed up against a wall, but mine is not.

product_metadata.title: KinCam Sectional Couch Covers 100% Waterproof L Shaped Sofa Covers 3pcs Sofa Slipcovers for Sectional Chaise Slipcover for Pets Kids, Small/Light Gray
features: 100% Waterproof & Comfortable: (This L shaped couch cover is Patented) KinCam L shaped sofa cover are made of high quality 100% waterproof polyester, which inner layer is filled with cotton, feel very cool to touch, comfortable and durable. It's suitable for most of the sectional couch.

Good Choice for Furniture Protector: Sectional couch cover can protect your sofa furniture from scratch, dust, dirt or pet hair. The waterproof design of the sofa cover keeps liquids (like water and beverages) from getting your sofa wet. And gives your old sofa a new look. It is ideal for homes with children and pets. A variety of colors to suit your home style.

Multiple Size Options: Our sectional couch covers are suitable for both left and right chaise. KinCam L-shaped sofa cover come with 3 pieces cover, one for the main sofa and the other two for the chaise . Please measure the size of your sofa before purchase, follow the Instructions to make sure that our sectional sofa covers can match your sofa.

Easy Installation: Easy to fit for your sofa with our user manual. Just drape the furniture with our covers, tuck the excess fabric into the gap between the back and couch cushion, then insert the non slip foam sticks into the gap to make it not easy to slide. Use the elastic straps secure the slipcover stay in place firmly.

Easy to Care: Hand wash or machine washable, wash at a temperature below 30 degrees Celsius. Do not bleach. Do not iron. We provide premium quality sofa cover, and focus on giving good customer service. Please contact us for any questions and we will be pleased to assist you.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash, Tumble dry low and no iron.
